title: 第一卷 第1章 要钱嫁我就行第一卷 第2章 天杀的谁告诉我修仙要清心寡欲
slug: 凡人修仙从百岁老人娶妻开始
lines: “林师伯，即刻下山去吧，你在宗内耗了八十载，修为停在炼气一层，未有寸进。
宗门养了你这么多年，算是对得起你了！”
年轻女修，对着老人行了一礼。
林寻苦笑一声：“清寒呢？她怎么没来？”
女修闻言眉头紧蹙，语气不善道：
“还请称师尊为柳长老，若不是你与师尊有旧，可当不得我这一声师伯。
师尊正闭关修炼，即将金丹，不便相见！”
林寻满是皱纹的脸上，充满苦涩：“金丹？八十载过去，柳长老竟已要金丹了么？”
说着，他低头打量自身干枯的手臂，释然的笑出声：“也好，也好啊！那老夫就告辞了。”
林寻抱了抱拳，简单收拾完包裹，就此离开仙门！
响水镇，此地被山水合抱，风景倒是秀丽。
林寻拖着疲惫的身躯，脸上隐隐有些激动。
“人生百年，浮游一日，终于在百岁之前，回到了这里！”
看到眼前景色，他不免心中感慨，自下山后，一时之间竟不知该去何处。
留在坊市继续修炼？
都已经百岁了，也该放下了，思来想去，还是回穿越来的第一站，颐养天年吧！
之后他乘马车用了近一年时间，经过森林、山地、平原，最终远离仙宗势力范围，回到了这里。
中间路途何止万里。
林寻不由叹息一声，
“想当年，为求仙缘，我从此地出发，花了近四年才到达仙宗，没想到却是那般境遇，可悲，可叹！”
按照这么算的话，他应该是穿越者里混的最差的了。
自幼父母双亡，一介孤儿游走四方，偶然救下柳清寒，两人相依为命，私定终身。
十九岁那年，遇仙宗收徒，他欣喜若狂。
接下来就是入仙门，得机缘，修大道，大杀四方，成一代仙尊！
但现实狠狠给了他一巴掌！
测灵根那天，他竟是空灵根，长老说他根弱几近无，难以存住灵气，都不能算作真正的灵根，不具备修仙资格！
要想修仙，必须有灵根，灵根一般分六等：杂品、下品、中品、上品、极品和天灵根。
杂灵根基本都难以修仙了。
下品灵根在修仙界是大多数，属芸芸众生。
中品灵根可谓人才，宗门培养的中坚力量。
上品灵根属天才，直接入内门重点照顾，获得大量的修行资源。
至于极品灵根和天灵根，那是真正的天骄。
数十年来林寻从未见过，连听都没听说过。
而空灵根？
就只比无灵根的凡人强一点。
可以感应灵气，但难以储存，每一次进阶都要面临瓶颈，所需的修炼资源堪称海量，有那功夫都能培养很多下品中品灵根的弟子。
这种人修炼就是在浪费资源！
可相对的却是柳清寒，上品灵根，天资卓绝，直接被收为内门大弟子！
content_en:
"Uncle Lin, please go down the mountain immediately. You have spent eighty years in the sect and your cultivation has stopped at the first level of Qi refining without making any progress.
The sect has raised you for so many years, so it deserves you! "
The young female cultivator bowed to the old man.
Lin Xun smiled bitterly: "Where is Qinghan? Why didn't she come?"
The female cultivator frowned when she heard this and said in a bad tone:
"Please also address Master as Elder Liu. If you hadn't had an old relationship with Master, you wouldn't be able to call me Uncle.
The master is practicing in seclusion and is about to receive the golden elixir. It is inconvenient to meet him! "
Lin Xun's wrinkled face was filled with bitterness: "Golden elixir? Eighty years have passed and Elder Liu actually wants the golden elixir?"
As he said that, he lowered his head and looked at his withered arms, and laughed with relief: "That's fine, that's fine! I'll take my leave then."
Lin Xun clasped his fists, simply packed up the package, and left the fairy gate!
...
Xiangshui Town is surrounded by mountains and rivers, and the scenery is beautiful.
Lin Xun dragged his tired body with a hint of excitement on his face.
"I lived a hundred years, drifted for a day, and finally returned here before I turned a hundred!"
Seeing the scenery in front of him, he couldn't help but sigh in his heart. After descending from the mountain, he didn't know where to go for a while.
Stay in Fangshi and continue practicing?
He is already a hundred years old, and it’s time to let it go. After much thought, he decided to go back to the first stop in time travel and enjoy his old age!
After that, he spent nearly a year riding a carriage, passing through forests, mountains, and plains, and finally returned here far away from the Xianzong's sphere of influence.
The journey in between is more than ten thousand miles.
Lin Xun couldn't help but sigh,
"I think back then, in order to seek immortality, I set out from here and spent nearly four years to reach the Immortal Sect. I didn't expect to be in such a situation. It's sad and deplorable!"
According to this calculation, he should be the worst among the time travellers.
Both of his parents died when he was young, and an orphan wandered around. He accidentally rescued Liu Qinghan, and the two depended on each other for life.
When he was nineteen years old, he was overjoyed when he met the Immortal Sect and accepted him as a disciple.
The next step is to enter the immortal sect, get the opportunity, cultivate the great road, kill everyone, and become a generation of immortals!
But reality slapped him hard!
On the day of the spiritual root test, he turned out to have empty spiritual roots. The elder said that his spiritual roots were weak and almost non-existent, and it was difficult to retain spiritual energy. He could not be considered a real spiritual root and was not qualified to cultivate as an immortal!
If you want to cultivate immortality, you must have spiritual roots. Spiritual roots are generally divided into six levels: miscellaneous, low-grade, medium-grade, top-grade, top-grade and heavenly spiritual roots.
It is basically difficult to cultivate immortality with mixed spiritual roots.
Low-grade spiritual roots are the majority in the world of immortality, and they belong to all living beings.
Middle-grade spiritual roots can be described as talents, the backbone cultivated by the sect.
High-grade spiritual roots belong to geniuses, and they can directly enter the inner sect for intensive care and obtain a large amount of cultivation resources.
As for the top spiritual roots and heavenly spiritual roots, they are the real geniuses.
Lin Xun had never seen or even heard of it in decades.
And the ethereal root?
Just a little stronger than a mortal without spiritual roots.
You can sense spiritual energy, but it is difficult to store it. Every time you advance, you will face a bottleneck. The training resources required are massive. With that kind of effort, you can cultivate many disciples with low- to medium-grade spiritual roots.
Such people are wasting resources by practicing cultivation!
But the opposite was Liu Qinghan, who had high-grade spiritual roots and outstanding talent, and was directly accepted as the inner sect's top disciple!
title_en: Volume 1, Chapter 1: Just marry me if you want money. Volume 1, Chapter 2: Who the hell told me that to cultivate immortality, I need to have a pure heart and few desires.
